page.notes: The text is a faded scan with some doubtful readings. Greek words marked [?] (ἐπαναλήψις, ἔπαινος, διήγησις) are uncertain. Several line-end references are hard to read: "conftet" and "Refponfio" were read with reasonable confidence, but the figures after "lib.10.epift.9.li." and "lib.6.epift.17." are doubtful. The words "Imitatio officiosæ epist." appear printed in italic, and the first note is in italic with a marked line break. Marginal notes: "Sententiarum collocatio & tractatio.", "Materiæ responsionum ad Epistolas officiosas.", "Imitatio officiosæ epist." The first and second notes are set in italic type as printed.
